name: MonarchNotificationsBell
title: NotificationsBell
summary: The entry to the notifications: a bell with the unread count, as a Material 3 IconButton with a BadgedBox, or as a labelled row.
whenToUse: In a top app bar (Icon) or a navigation drawer or menu (Row), to open the app's notifications and show how many are unread.
whenNotToUse: For a count on a bottom navigation destination use the badge parameter of NavigationBarItem. For the list of notifications itself use the app's own screen or ModalBottomSheet.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchNotificationsBell(onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, unreadCount: Int = 0, variant: MonarchNotificationsBellVariant = MonarchNotificationsBellVariant.Icon, enabled: Boolean = true, title: String? = null, unreadLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, icon: @Composable () -> Unit)
public enum class MonarchNotificationsBellVariant { Icon, Row }

options.name: onClick
options.description: Opens the notifications: show a ModalBottomSheet or navigate to a screen.

options.name: unreadCount
options.description: The number of unread notifications. Zero or less shows no badge. Above 99 the badge reads "99+".

options.name: variant
options.description: Icon: a 48dp icon button with the count on the bell. Row: a row with the bell, the title and the count at the end.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the person can open the notifications.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in name "Notifications", which is also the visible title of a row.

options.name: unreadLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in state "3 unread". Pass the whole phrase for the current count.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the button or the row.

options.name: icon
options.description: The bell. Monarch bundles no icons; pass a MonarchIcon with a null content description. It is hidden from TalkBack.

states.name: unread
states.description: A badge with the count in the solid danger color, on the bell (Icon) or at the end of the row (Row).

states.name: none unread
states.description: No badge and no state description.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The bell and the title use the disabled text color; announced as disabled.

appearance: The bell and the row title use the default text color; the badge is the Material 3 Badge filled with the solid danger color and its on-solid text, in every theme. High-contrast themes change only the roles.
platformNotes: On the web the bell owns the NotificationCenter panel and passes its props through (items, filters, mark as read, load more, a See all link). On Android, as on iOS, this component is only the trigger with the count: the app presents its notifications from onClick, so there is no open state, panel side, closeOnSelect or seeAllHref. The web derives the count from unread items when unreadCount is missing; here the app always passes it. The web's collapsed row (icon only with a tooltip, for a collapsed rail) is the Icon variant. Monarch bundles no icons, so the bell is a required slot here; iOS uses the system bell symbol. The "99+" text is the same on every platform and is not translated.
accessibility: One TalkBack element with the button role, named "Notifications" (or title).
The unread count is the state description ("3 unread", a plural resource), not part of the name. It is the exact count even when the badge shows "99+", and it is absent when nothing is unread.
The bell and the badge are hidden from TalkBack, so the count is read once; an icon description passed by the app is not read.
The touch target is at least 48dp by 48dp in both variants and reserved in the layout.
The row title wraps at font scale 2.0.
The unread state is a badge with a number, not a color change.
edgeCases: A negative count is treated as zero.
Counts above 99 show "99+" in the badge.
A long row title wraps; the badge stays at the end.

examples.title: Icon button with See all
examples.setupTemplate:
var showNotifications by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
var read by remember { mutableStateOf(setOf<String>()) }
val items = listOf(
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.0.id}},
        title = {{items.0.title}},
        time = {{items.0.time|millis}},
        read = {{items.0.id}} in read,
        actorName = {{items.0.actor}},
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.1.id}},
        title = {{items.1.title}},
        time = {{items.1.time|millis}},
        message = {{items.1.description}},
        read = {{items.1.id}} in read,
        actorName = {{items.1.actor}},
    ),
    MonarchNotificationCenterItem(
        id = {{items.2.id}},
        title = {{items.2.title}},
        time = {{items.2.time|millis}},
        read = {{items.2.id}} in read || {{items.2.read}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Bell, contentDescription = null, size = MonarchIconSize.Sm) },
    ),
)
